title: Biennial renewal; failure to renew.
bodyText: The biennial renewal fee shall be paid to the department of health on or before December 31 of each even-numbered year. Failure, neglect, or refusal of any licensee to pay the biennial renewal fee on or before such date shall constitute a forfeiture of the license.
bodyHtml: [§321-381]  Biennial renewal; failure to renew.  The biennial renewal fee shall be paid to the department of health on or before December 31 of each even-numbered year.  Failure, neglect, or refusal of any licensee to pay the biennial renewal fee on or before such date shall constitute a forfeiture of the license. [L 1990, c 285, pt of §2]
